create_Dropout: create a Dropout layer that randomly zeroes elements with a given probability during training
create_Dropout2d: create a Dropout2d layer that randomly zeros entire 2D channels for Conv2d feature maps
create_Dropout3d: create a Dropout3d layer that randomly zeros entire 3D channels for Conv3d feature maps
create_AlphaDropout: create an AlphaDropout layer that maintains self-normalizing property with SELU activation
create_FeatureAlphaDropout: create a FeatureAlphaDropout layer that masks entire channels to SELU negative saturation values
